//: Northflank — a manual/scheduled job that gates on dependency drift.
Northflank builds from a repository and runs jobs in the built image, so
depwatch runs as a job with the repository as its build context. A
non-zero exit fails the job run, which is the gate.
Northflank clones a single commit, so there is no base to ratchet
against — the absolute budget is the gate that fits here. Schedule it
rather than only running it on push: drift grows while nobody commits.
Create with: northflank create job --file northflank-job.json
name: depwatch
description: Dependency drift (libyears) x viability, gated on a threshold.
